text:
Alex K: Heads-up — scheduled schema migration for user_events is still on for Fri 22:00 UTC (our usual low-traffic slot). Planning a 30m dual-write window + backfill segments.
Maya S: Confirming: who is the primary owner for the slot? I can cover rollback steps if needed.
Alex K: Ben will drive the migration, Jamie will run rollback/drill if we need to abort, Maya you own the smoke tests and data checks.
Ben P: Assigned. I'll be doing the live cutover and monitoring. ETA to start migration prep is 21:30 UTC for prechecks.
Jamie L: I'll be on standby from 21:45 UTC. If we see >2% missing events or write error rate spike we revert to the previous write flag and rollback backfill index ranges.
Priya R: Quick ask — do we have the backfill segmentation plan? I want the list of shard ranges I'll validate post-backfill.
Ben P: Yes — segments are: [A: 0000-0fff], [B:1000-1fff], [C:2000-2fff], [D:3000-3fff]. We'll run in that order, stop on any fail. Full plan in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/user_events_migration
Maya S: Smoke checklist (short):
- run canary write to v2 and confirm read-through within 30s
- query sample user ids for event counts (curl to /api/ops/sample-events)
- check replication lag < 200ms on replicas
- confirm alerting dashboard shows no token errors
I'll post short commands 30m before start.
deploy-bot: Reminder — maintenance window reservation confirmed for Fri 22:00 UTC, reserved pool: dedicated-migrate-01. Pager duty: on-call infra (Priya R).
Priya R: I will take infra pager for the window. Ben/ Jamie ping me directly if you want the emergency rollback run.
Alex K: Rollback drill: Jamie will run a dry-run revert at 21:50 on staging. Production rollback procedure:
1) flip writes back to v1 feature flag
2) stop dual-write daemon
3) run targeted tombstone on partial backfill segments if partially applied
4) notify customers + update status page
Jamie L: I'll post the exact commands during the staging drill. Suggest we set the abort criteria: any rolling error rate >1.5% for 5m or backfill miss rate >0.8%.
Ben P: Agreed. Also note: KV cache priming will take ~3m after cutover — include that in smoke baseline.
Maya S: Commands I'll run (for quick copy/paste):
```
# canary write
curl -X POST https://api.internal/user_events -d '{"id":"canary-$(date +%s)","event":"ping"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MIG_TOKEN'
# sample counts
curl -s https://ops.internal/sample-events?ids=canary | jq .count
```
Alex K: Final checklist for tonight:
- 21:30 prep checks (Ben)
- 21:45 staging rollback dry-run (Jamie)
- 21:50 final signoff (Alex/Maya/Priya)
- 22:00 start dual-write
- 22:30 begin backfill segments
- 23:00 expected finish (variable)
Ben P: I'll update this thread live with timestamps and short statuses. If anyone can't make the window, call out now.
Priya R: All good from infra side. I'll also watch network egress and disk IO during backfill.
Maya S: I'll be in /call for the window: zoom.link/ue-migration
Alex K: Thanks — tagging infra and oncall. :thumbsup:
